templates.name: Order Service Unresponsive
templates.short_description: Order Service not responding to health checks
templates.description:
Order Service at port 8080 is not responding to /health endpoint.

Symptoms:
- Orders failing for all customers
- Grafana showing 100% error rate on Order Service
- Cart Service logging connection timeouts

Immediate actions:
1. Check pod/container status
2. Check logs for errors
3. Attempt restart
4. If restart fails, escalate to L3

templates.name: Payment Gateway Timeout
templates.short_description: Payment gateway returning timeouts - orders stuck
templates.description:
External payment gateway is not responding.

Impact: No orders can complete payment. All new orders stuck in PAYMENT_PENDING.

Immediate actions:
1. Verify gateway status page
2. Enable circuit breaker fallback
3. Log affected orders for reprocessing
4. Notify stakeholders
5. Contact gateway vendor if outage > 15 min

templates.name: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
templates.short_description: MongoDB/MySQL connection pool at capacity - requests queuing
templates.description:
Database connection pool is exhausted.

Symptoms:
- Increased latency across all services
- Grafana showing db_pool_active near max
- Timeout errors in logs

Immediate actions:
1. Check active connections: db.serverStatus().connections (MongoDB) or SHOW STATUS LIKE 'Threads_connected' (MySQL)
2. Identify leaking service
3. Restart the leaking service
4. Monitor pool recovery

templates.name: High Error Rate Alert
templates.description:
Prometheus alert: error rate exceeded 5% for 2+ minutes.

Investigation steps:
1. Check Grafana dashboard for affected service
2. Check logs for error patterns
3. Identify if caused by recent deployment
4. Rollback if deployment-related
5. Fix and redeploy if code bug

templates.name: SSL Certificate Expiry
templates.description:
SSL certificate for foodexpress.example.com has expired or is about to expire.

Impact: Users see security warnings, browsers block access.

Resolution:
1. Generate/renew certificate
2. Install new certificate
3. Restart Apache/Nginx
4. Verify HTTPS works
5. Set up monitoring for next expiry

templates.name: Restaurant Search Slow
templates.short_description: Restaurant search taking 3+ seconds - customers abandoning
templates.description:
Restaurant search latency has increased significantly.

Symptoms:
- Search takes 3+ seconds (normal is <500ms)
- Grafana p95 latency panel spiking
- Customers reporting slow search on mobile

Investigation:
1. Check MongoDB text index exists: db.restaurants.getIndexes()
2. Run explain on search query
3. Check container resource usage
4. Rebuild index if missing

templates.name: Delivery Tracking Not Updating
templates.short_description: Delivery status not updating - customers seeing stale ETA
templates.description:
Delivery Service at port 3002 is not updating delivery status.

Impact: Customers see stale delivery ETAs, support calls increasing.

Immediate actions:
1. Check Delivery Service health: curl http://localhost:3002/health
2. Check MongoDB connection for deliveries collection
3. Check event listener for order status changes
4. Restart Delivery Service if needed
